Reconstruct chat speed over a YouTube live stream from its public live-chat
replay, then rank the stretches where chat reacts fastest. Source:
[Lawrence-lugs/auto_clipper](https://github.com/Lawrence-lugs/auto_clipper).

## Documents

- [Chat rate report](chat_rate.html) — the full experiment on a real stream,
  with interactive Plotly charts and the current top segments.
- [Segmentation algorithm](segmentation.html) — threshold design, related work,
  parameter reference, results, and known failure modes.
